- Shape: `l1-face.mjs --pr 36540` CLEAN at e735eb1197: draft, base `main`, `Fixes #36512` on line 3 (after the two attribution lines), no closing keyword near any other card, changeset for `@object-ui/i18n` + `@object-ui/app-shell` (patch), `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`; Skills-docs not owed. Changeset read sentence by sentence against the diff: each claim (two parts, developer section last and expanded, key small print outside the label, three rewrites, optional `split` prop with whole-panel default) matches the code.
- Premise: measured by the seat before the claim (claim 7082449740) and re-measured by the dev; the file surface was widened once by the seat (comment after report 7082981555) to the shared object inspector and its registry prop, and the diff stays inside the amended surface (10 files).
- Gates: check-runs at e735eb1197 — 45 success · 13 expected skip · 0 unexpected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending; Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check both `success`. Dev's local reconciliation: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (`/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/36512-gates-ran.txt`). Ablations: key moved inside the label ⇒ 2/9 red; developer mount given `part: 'business'` ⇒ 5/14 red; both restored to HEAD.
- Spot reads of the diff: `ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx` — `SettingHeading` puts `SettingKey` (select-all `<code>`) beside a `<label htmlFor>`, so the control's accessible name is the title alone; the developer section mounts the same registered inspector with `split.part = 'developer'` only when one is registered. `ObjectDefaultInspector.tsx` — without `split` the panel is the same `InspectorShell` tree as before (name row + business rows + access section); `KeyedTextField` is `InspectorTextField` when `aside` is absent. `default-inspector-registry.ts` — one optional prop; `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, so no published type moves (Clause-② `no` holds; the studio catalogues stay `Record<string, string>`). Strings: every `engine.studio.settings.*` value lost its ADR numbers, rule codes and parenthesised keys in en and zh; the studio namespace ships en and zh only.
- Accepted deviations: (1) the before/after screenshots are of the showcase object (`showcase_account`, read-only from a code package), not a self-built "customer" object — same component tree; saved at `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/36512-shots/`. (2) The maintainer quick-read has four lines per `os-dev.md`, not the six the dispatch order asked; `os-dev.md` wins by the order's own rule. (3) `KeyedTextField` repeats `InspectorTextField`'s body instead of adding an `aside` slot to `_shared.tsx`, which was outside the surface — nit, not a defect.
- Out of scope: the spec's `controlled_by_parent` refusal still cites `ADR-0055 §1` in one state (sharing "follows its parent", no usable master-detail field) — carrier: #36526 (filed by the seat), named in the PR's Acceptance notes. Re-worded `designer.object.*` strings also show in the inspector's other hosts (create-object, bundle-item editor) — same meaning, consistent wording, by design.
- Landing: not governed (`check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 36540`: 0 of 10 paths), 807 changed lines ≤ 3000; main is 7 commits past the merge base, none on this PR's files (`landing-k` could not answer: no Test Core shard ran on a UI-only head). Area lands it: ready + auto-merge in this stroke.
